atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: list_cons
atoms.rule: a ⊲ b places integer a before the elements of list b.
atoms.plain: a ⊲ b places integer a before the elements of list b.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊲ b 把整数 a 放到列表 b 的最前面。

atoms.name: list_head
atoms.rule: a ⌃ is the first integer in a; an empty list gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a ⌃ is the first integer in a; an empty list gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⌃ 是列表 a 的第一个元素，空列表得 NaN。

atoms.name: list_tail
atoms.rule: a ⌄ removes the first element of a; an empty list stays empty.
atoms.plain: a ⌄ removes the first element of a; an empty list stays empty.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⌄ 去掉列表 a 的第一个元素，空列表保持为空。

atoms.name: list_length
atoms.rule: a ℒ is the number of integers in list a.
atoms.plain: a ℒ is the number of integers in list a.
atoms.plain_zh: a ℒ 是列表 a 的元素个数。

atoms.name: list_append
atoms.rule: a ⊞ b joins list a followed by list b.
atoms.plain: a ⊞ b joins list a followed by list b.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊞ b 把列表 b 接在 a 后面。

atoms.name: list_sum
atoms.rule: a Σ is the sum of the integers in list a.
atoms.plain: a Σ is the sum of the integers in list a.
atoms.plain_zh: a Σ 是列表 a 所有元素之和。

atoms.name: list_at
atoms.rule: a ⊙ b is element b of a, counting from zero; an invalid index gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a ⊙ b is element b of a, counting from zero; an invalid index gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊙ b 是列表 a 中下标为 b 的元素，下标从零数，越界得 NaN。

atoms.name: list_equal
atoms.rule: a ≍ b is true exactly when lists a and b have the same elements in order.
atoms.plain: a ≍ b is true exactly when lists a and b have the same elements in order.
atoms.plain_zh: a ≍ b 在两个列表元素和顺序都相同时为真。

domain.en: Values are lists of integers and integers. Lists may be empty; an index counts from zero.
domain.zh: 取值是整数列表和整数。列表可以为空，下标从零数起。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms.
A recursive call repeats its step at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.
settings.zh: 递归最多重复这么多步，更大的次数得 NaN。

settings.en: The largest number of cases in a branch definition.
settings.zh: 分支定义最多的情形数。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♤₁
operators.plain: Put the first element of a at the front of [].
operators.plain_zh: 把「a 的第一个元素」放到 [] 最前面。

operators.name: ▲₂
operators.plain: If a equals [], append a without its first element to [1, 2]; otherwise drop the first element of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，在 [1, 2] 后面接上「去掉首元素的 a」；否则去掉 a 的第一个元素。

operators.name: ■₃
operators.definition: a ■₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ■₃ (b - 1)) ⌄, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ■₃ (b + 1)) ⌄, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): drop the first element of the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：去掉结果的第一个元素（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ◆₄
operators.plain: Put the first element of a at the front of [1, 2].
operators.plain_zh: 把「a 的第一个元素」放到 [1, 2] 最前面。

operators.name: ▲₅
operators.plain: Apply ▼₃₅ to a, then prepend 4 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₃₅，再把 4 放到结果最前面。

operators.name: ▲₆
operators.plain: Take element b of a, counting from zero, then subtract 3 from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先取 a 中下标为 b 的元素，再从结果中减去 3。

operators.name: ◆₇
operators.plain: Test whether [1] equals a followed by b.
operators.plain_zh: 判断 [1] 是否等于「a 后接 b」。

operators.name: ○₈
operators.plain: Drop the first element of a, then add up its elements.
operators.plain_zh: 先去掉 a 的第一个元素，再把结果的元素加起来。

operators.name: ♧₉
operators.plain: Append b to a, then take element 3 from it, counting from zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再取结果中下标为 3 的元素。

operators.name: □₁₀
operators.plain: Apply ♧₉ to [1, 2] and (a followed by b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [1, 2] 和「a 后接 b」应用 ♧₉。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ●₁₁
operators.plain: Add a ▲₆ b to 2.
operators.plain_zh: 把 2 加上 a ▲₆ b。

operators.name: ♧₁₂
operators.plain: Take element b of a, counting from zero, then add 2 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先取 a 中下标为 b 的元素，再把结果加上 2。

operators.name: ☆₁₃
operators.plain: Subtract the first element of a from 4.
operators.plain_zh: 从 4 中减去「a 的第一个元素」。

operators.name: ★₁₄
operators.plain: Put a at the front of b, then apply □₁₀ to the result and [].
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 放到 b 最前面，再对结果和 [] 应用 □₁₀。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ●₁₅
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply ◆₄ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ◆₄。

operators.name: ♣₁₆
operators.plain: Add element b of a to 4.
operators.plain_zh: 把 4 加上「a 中下标为 b 的元素」。

operators.name: ♢₁₇
operators.plain: Add the first element of a to 3.
operators.plain_zh: 把 3 加上「a 的第一个元素」。

operators.name: ♣₁₈
operators.plain: Subtract a ♢₁₇ from 2.
operators.plain_zh: 从 2 中减去 a ♢₁₇。

operators.name: ◇₁₉
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply ♣₁₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ♣₁₈。

operators.name: ★₂₀
operators.definition: a ★₂₀ b = { 2 + (a ⊙ b), if a ≍ [1, 2]; a ⊙ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 2], add element b of a to 2; otherwise take element b of a, counting from zero.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1, 2]，把 2 加上「a 中下标为 b 的元素」；否则取 a 中下标为 b 的元素。

operators.name: ♢₂₁
operators.definition: a ♢₂₁ = { [2, 3] ♣₁₆ (a Σ), if a ≍ []; a Σ, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], add up the elements of a, then apply ♣₁₆ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise add up the elements of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先把 a 的元素加起来，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♣₁₆；否则把 a 的元素加起来。

operators.name: ♢₂₂
operators.definition: a ♢₂₂ b = { [2, 3] ♧₁₂ (a ★₂₀ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ★₂₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ★₂₀ to a and b, then apply ♧₁₂ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise compute a ★₂₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ★₂₀，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♧₁₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ★₂₀。

operators.name: ♣₂₃
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♣₁₈ to a, then apply ▲₆ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise apply ♣₁₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♣₁₈，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ▲₆；否则对 a 应用 ♣₁₈。

operators.name: ♥₂₄
operators.definition: a ♥₂₄ b = { [2, 3] ♣₁₆ (a ♧₁₂ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ♧₁₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♧₁₂ to a and b, then apply ♣₁₆ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise compute a ♧₁₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₁₂，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♣₁₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₁₂。

operators.name: ♥₂₅
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♣₁₈ to a, then apply ♢₂₂ to [1, 2] and the result; otherwise apply ♣₁₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 应用 ♣₁₈，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ♢₂₂；否则对 a 应用 ♣₁₈。

operators.name: ♦₂₆
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], subtract the first element of a from 1; otherwise take the first element of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，从 1 中减去「a 的第一个元素」；否则取 a 的第一个元素。

operators.name: ★₂₇
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♦₂₆ to a, then apply ●₁₁ to [] and the result; otherwise apply ♦₂₆ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♦₂₆，再对 [] 和结果应用 ●₁₁；否则对 a 应用 ♦₂₆。

operators.name: ★₂₈
operators.definition: a ★₂₈ b = { 0 - (a ◇₁₉ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ◇₁₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], subtract a ◇₁₉ b from 0; otherwise compute a ◇₁₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，从 0 中减去 a ◇₁₉ b；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₉。

operators.name: ♦₂₉
operators.definition: a ♦₂₉ = { [] ●₁₁ (a ℒ), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ℒ, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], count the elements of a, then apply ●₁₁ to [] and the result; otherwise count the elements of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先数 a 有几个元素，再对 [] 和结果应用 ●₁₁；否则数 a 有几个元素。

operators.name: ●₃₀
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♢₂₁ to a, then apply ♢₂₂ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise apply ♢₂₁ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 应用 ♢₂₁，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♢₂₂；否则对 a 应用 ♢₂₁。

operators.name: ▲₃₁
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply ♦₂₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ♦₂₆。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♠₃₂
operators.plain: Apply ♦₂₆ to a, then subtract 1 from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♦₂₆，再从结果中减去 1。

operators.name: ♥₃₃
operators.plain: If a equals [1], append a ◆₄ to [2, 3]; otherwise apply ◆₄ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，在 [2, 3] 后面接上 a ◆₄；否则对 a 应用 ◆₄。

operators.name: ♢₃₄
operators.plain: Put a □₁₀ b at the front of [1].
operators.plain_zh: 把 a □₁₀ b 放到 [1] 最前面。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ▼₃₅
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♥₃₃ to a, then drop its first element; otherwise apply ♥₃₃ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♥₃₃，再去掉结果的第一个元素；否则对 a 应用 ♥₃₃。

operators.name: ♡₃₆
operators.plain: Apply ◆₇ to [] and (b with a put in front).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [] 和「前面加上 a 的 b」应用 ◆₇。

operators.name: ○₃₇
operators.plain: Add a ♥₂₄ b to 4.
operators.plain_zh: 把 4 加上 a ♥₂₄ b。

operators.name: ♢₃₈
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ☆₁₃ to a, then negate it; otherwise apply ☆₁₃ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 应用 ☆₁₃，再把结果取相反数；否则对 a 应用 ☆₁₃。

operators.name: ☆₃₉
operators.definition: a ☆₃₉ b = { [] ●₁₁ (a ◇₁₉ b), if a ≍ []; a ◇₁₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ◇₁₉ to a and b, then apply ●₁₁ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ◇₁₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₉，再对 [] 和结果应用 ●₁₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₉。

operators.name: ◆₄₀
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♢₂₁ to a, then apply ♥₂₄ to [1] and the result; otherwise apply ♢₂₁ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♢₂₁，再对 [1] 和结果应用 ♥₂₄；否则对 a 应用 ♢₂₁。

operators.name: ●₄₁
operators.plain: Subtract element b of a from 4.
operators.plain_zh: 从 4 中减去「a 中下标为 b 的元素」。

operators.name: ♧₄₂
operators.definition: a ♧₄₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♧₄₂ (b - 1)) ◆₄, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♧₄₂ (b + 1)) ◆₄, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ◆₄ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ◆₄（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ☆₄₃
operators.definition: a ☆₄₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ☆₄₃ (b - 1)) ♥₃₃, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ☆₄₃ (b + 1)) ♥₃₃, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♥₃₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♥₃₃（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ★₄₄
operators.definition: a ★₄₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ★₄₄ (b - 1)) ▲₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ★₄₄ (b + 1)) ▲₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▲₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ▲₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♠₄₅
operators.definition: a ♠₄₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♠₄₅ (b - 1)) ▼₃₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♠₄₅ (b + 1)) ▼₃₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▼₃₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ▼₃₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ◇₄₆
operators.definition: a ◇₄₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ◇₄₆ (b - 1)) ▲₂, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ◇₄₆ (b + 1)) ▲₂, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▲₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ▲₂（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: □₄₇
operators.definition: a □₄₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a □₄₇ (b - 1)) ♤₁, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a □₄₇ (b + 1)) ♤₁, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♤₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♤₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♡₄₈
operators.plain: Apply ♧₉ to [1] and (a ★₄₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [1] 和 a ★₄₄ b 应用 ♧₉。

operators.name: ◇₄₉
operators.plain: Apply ♧₁₂ to (a □₄₇ b) and 0.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a □₄₇ b 和 0 应用 ♧₁₂。

operators.name: ♦₅₀
operators.plain: Apply ▲₃₁ to [] and (a ★₄₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [] 和 a ★₄₄ b 应用 ▲₃₁。

operators.name: ◆₅₁
operators.plain: Apply □₄₇ to a and b, then test whether the result equals [].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₄₇，再判断结果是否等于 []。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ○₅₂
operators.plain: Apply ♧₄₂ to a and b, then apply ★₂₈ to the result and [1].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₄₂，再对结果和 [1] 应用 ★₂₈。

operators.name: ♡₅₃
operators.plain: Apply ☆₄₃ to a and b, then add up its elements.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₄₃，再把结果的元素加起来。

operators.name: ▲₅₄
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₆ to a and b, then apply ▼₃₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₆，再对结果应用 ▼₃₅。

operators.name: ▼₅₅
operators.plain: Apply □₄₇ to a and b, then apply ◆₅₁ to the result and 2.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₄₇，再对结果和 2 应用 ◆₅₁。

operators.name: ♣₅₆
operators.plain: Apply ♡₄₈ to a and b, then subtract 1 from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈，再从结果中减去 1。

operators.name: △₅₇
operators.plain: Apply ■₃ to a and b, then apply ♦₂₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₃，再对结果应用 ♦₂₉。

operators.name: ●₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₆ to a and b, then apply ☆₁₃ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₆，再对结果应用 ☆₁₃。

operators.name: ♧₅₉
operators.plain: Apply ☆₄₃ to a and b, then apply ★₂₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₄₃，再对结果应用 ★₂₇。

operators.name: ▲₆₀
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₆ to a and b, then apply ♢₁₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₆，再对结果应用 ♢₁₇。

operators.name: ▽₆₁
operators.plain: Apply ♠₄₅ to a and b, then apply ▲₂ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₄₅，再对结果应用 ▲₂。

operators.name: ♤₆₂
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₆ to a and b, then apply ♥₂₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₆，再对结果应用 ♥₂₅。

operators.name: ◆₆₃
operators.definition: a ◆₆₃ b = { (a ☆₄₃ b) ▲₂, if a ≍ [1]; a ☆₄₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ☆₄₃ to a and b, then apply ▲₂ to the result; otherwise compute a ☆₄₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₄₃，再对结果应用 ▲₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₄₃。

operators.name: ▲₆₄
operators.definition: a ▲₆₄ b = { 1 % (a △₅₇ b), if a ≍ [1]; a △₅₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], take the remainder when dividing 1 by a △₅₇ b; otherwise compute a △₅₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，求 1 除以 a △₅₇ b 的余数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 △₅₇。

operators.name: △₆₅
operators.definition: a △₆₅ b = { (a ▲₆₀ b) + 4, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ▲₆₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ▲₆₀ to a and b, then add 4 to it; otherwise compute a ▲₆₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₆₀，再把结果加上 4；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₆₀。

operators.name: ○₆₆
operators.definition: a ○₆₆ b = { (a ■₃ b) ▽₆₁ 0, if a ≍ []; a ■₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ■₃ to a and b, then apply ▽₆₁ to the result and 0; otherwise compute a ■₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₃，再对结果和 0 应用 ▽₆₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₃。

operators.name: ◇₆₇
operators.definition: a ◇₆₇ b = { [] ♣₁₆ (a ♣₅₆ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♣₅₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♣₅₆ to a and b, then apply ♣₁₆ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ♣₅₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₅₆，再对 [] 和结果应用 ♣₁₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₅₆。

operators.name: ○₆₈
operators.definition: a ○₆₈ b = { [] ♢₂₂ (a ●₅₈ b), if a ≍ []; a ●₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ●₅₈ to a and b, then apply ♢₂₂ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ●₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₈，再对 [] 和结果应用 ♢₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₈。

operators.name: ♡₆₉
operators.definition: a ♡₆₉ b = { [] ♧₁₂ (a ◇₄₉ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ◇₄₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ◇₄₉ to a and b, then apply ♧₁₂ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ◇₄₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₉，再对 [] 和结果应用 ♧₁₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₉。

operators.name: ▼₇₀
operators.definition: a ▼₇₀ b = { [1, 2] ▲₆₀ (a ●₅₈ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ●₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ●₅₈ to a and b, then apply ▲₆₀ to [1, 2] and the result; otherwise compute a ●₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₈，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ▲₆₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₈。

operators.name: ○₇₁
operators.definition: a ○₇₁ b = { (a ▲₅₄ b) ▽₆₁ 2, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ▲₅₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ▲₅₄ to a and b, then apply ▽₆₁ to the result and 2; otherwise compute a ▲₅₄ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₄，再对结果和 2 应用 ▽₆₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₄。

operators.name: ♡₇₂
operators.definition: a ♡₇₂ b = { [1] △₆₅ (a ♤₆₂ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♤₆₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♤₆₂ to a and b, then apply △₆₅ to [1] and the result; otherwise compute a ♤₆₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₂，再对 [1] 和结果应用 △₆₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₂。

operators.name: ☆₇₃
operators.definition: a ☆₇₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ☆₇₃ (b - 1)) ○₇₁ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ☆₇₃ (b + 1)) ○₇₁ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ○₇₁ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ○₇₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ●₇₄
operators.definition: a ●₇₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ●₇₄ (b - 1)) ▲₅₄ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ●₇₄ (b + 1)) ▲₅₄ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▲₅₄ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ▲₅₄（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♥₇₅
operators.definition: a ♥₇₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♥₇₅ (b - 1)) ▽₆₁ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♥₇₅ (b + 1)) ▽₆₁ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▽₆₁ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ▽₆₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♡₇₆
operators.definition: a ♡₇₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♡₇₆ (b - 1)) ◆₆₃ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♡₇₆ (b + 1)) ◆₆₃ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ◆₆₃ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ◆₆₃（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▽₇₇
operators.definition: a ▽₇₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▽₇₇ (b - 1)) ○₆₆ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▽₇₇ (b + 1)) ○₆₆ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ○₆₆ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ○₆₆（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▲₇₈
operators.plain: Apply ♥₂₄ to (a ♥₇₅ b) and 2.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a ♥₇₅ b 和 2 应用 ♥₂₄。

operators.name: ▽₇₉
operators.plain: Apply □₁₀ to [] and (a ▽₇₇ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [] 和 a ▽₇₇ b 应用 □₁₀。

operators.name: ■₈₀
operators.plain: Apply ▽₇₉ to a and b, then apply ▲₆₀ to [2, 3] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₇₉，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ▲₆₀。

operators.name: ♥₈₁
operators.plain: Subtract a ▲₇₈ b from 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 1 中减去 a ▲₇₈ b。

operators.name: ▽₈₂
operators.plain: Apply ♥₈₁ to a and b, then apply △₅₇ to [2, 3] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₈₁，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 △₅₇。

operators.name: ▲₈₃
operators.plain: Test whether [1, 2] equals a ☆₇₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 判断 [1, 2] 是否等于 a ☆₇₃ b。

operators.name: ♦₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇₅ to a and b, then apply ♧₉ to the result and [1].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₅，再对结果和 [1] 应用 ♧₉。

operators.name: ♢₈₅
operators.plain: Apply ☆₇₃ to a and b, then apply ★₂₈ to the result and [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₇₃，再对结果和 [2, 3] 应用 ★₂₈。

operators.name: ♡₈₆
operators.plain: Apply ♦₈₄ to a and b, then apply ♡₇₂ to [] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₈₄，再对 [] 和结果应用 ♡₇₂。

operators.name: ♤₈₇
operators.plain: Apply ♡₆₉ to (a ♡₇₆ b) and 2.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a ♡₇₆ b 和 2 应用 ♡₆₉。

operators.name: ▲₈₈
operators.plain: Put a ■₈₀ b at the front of [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 把 a ■₈₀ b 放到 [2, 3] 最前面。

operators.name: □₈₉
operators.definition: a □₈₉ b = { (a ♥₇₅ b) ○₆₆ 4, if a ≍ [1]; a ♥₇₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♥₇₅ to a and b, then apply ○₆₆ to the result and 4; otherwise compute a ♥₇₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₅，再对结果和 4 应用 ○₆₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₅。

operators.name: △₉₀
operators.definition: a △₉₀ b = { [1] △₅₇ (a ♤₈₇ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ♤₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♤₈₇ to a and b, then apply △₅₇ to [1] and the result; otherwise compute a ♤₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₈₇，再对 [1] 和结果应用 △₅₇；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₈₇。

operators.name: ○₉₁
operators.definition: a ○₉₁ b = { (a ☆₇₃ b) ▲₈₈ 3, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ☆₇₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ☆₇₃ to a and b, then apply ▲₈₈ to the result and 3; otherwise compute a ☆₇₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₇₃，再对结果和 3 应用 ▲₈₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₇₃。

operators.name: ●₉₂
operators.definition: a ●₉₂ b = { (a □₈₉ b) ♤₁, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a □₈₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply □₈₉ to a and b, then apply ♤₁ to the result; otherwise compute a □₈₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 □₈₉，再对结果应用 ♤₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 □₈₉。

operators.name: ♠₉₃
operators.definition: a ♠₉₃ b = { [1] ♧₅₉ (a ▽₇₉ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ▽₇₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ▽₇₉ to a and b, then apply ♧₅₉ to [1] and the result; otherwise compute a ▽₇₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₇₉，再对 [1] 和结果应用 ♧₅₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₇₉。

operators.name: ○₉₄
operators.definition: a ○₉₄ b = { (a ●₇₄ b) ▽₆₁ 1, if a ≍ [1]; a ●₇₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ●₇₄ to a and b, then apply ▽₆₁ to the result and 1; otherwise compute a ●₇₄ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₇₄，再对结果和 1 应用 ▽₆₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₇₄。

operators.name: ♢₉₅
operators.definition: a ♢₉₅ b = { [] ●₅₈ (a ♤₈₇ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♤₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♤₈₇ to a and b, then apply ●₅₈ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ♤₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₈₇，再对 [] 和结果应用 ●₅₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₈₇。
